capabilities: Log media entries directly in daily notes
Tag entries by media type (movies, TV, variety shows, books)
Store title and short review in a single line
Browse records and monthly stats filtered by year and month
Rename app title and media type labels in settings
disambiguation: Not a general journaling or diary tool; it only tracks media entries logged inside daily notes.
extras: The README includes a Chinese-language section (中文说明); the manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
intentEvidence: Auto-detect journal folder and date format from the core Daily Notes plugin when available.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to record watched or read media in daily notes and then browse those entries with filters and monthly overview stats.

relations.evidence: Auto-detect journal folder and date format from the core Daily Notes plugin when available.

summary: Media tracker that logs books, movies, TV shows, and variety programs from daily notes, with tags, one-line comments, and monthly stats.
